reason: I want to capture the processor's waste heat for later, and fitting the recovery coil to the insulated tank seems like a natural way to start.
expectation: I expect a heat-storage assembly, though it may still need connecting to the processor.

alternatives.reason: This looks useful for the adjustable screen, but I want to build the heat store first.

effect: The coil and tank formed a water heat store, which appears ready to connect to the processor.
reaction: The result matches what I expected, though I’m curious how it will release heat slowly.
reason: Connecting the store to the processor should let it capture heat for the night.
expectation: I expect the processor to fill and heat the store, though it may need another step before it can warm the cabin.

alternatives.reason: The quilt stock and frame sections look like the start of the bench screen, but I want to finish connecting the heat store first.

effect: The processor fills and warms the tank through a separate heat-exchange circuit, completing the heat store for the root zone.
reaction: I like the practical detail that the stored warmth can carry the roots through part of the night.
reason: The adjustable screen is the remaining goal, and combining the quilt stock with the frame sections is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect this to make a framed screen, though it may still need to be fitted around the bench.

effect: The quilt stock and frame sections made an insulated inner screen, ready to fit to the bench.
reaction: That matches my expectation; I’m curious how the screen will adjust.
reason: Fitting the screen to the window bench is the only available combination and should advance the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect an adjustable screen around the bench, though it may need further work.

effect: The screen forms an insulated growing nook around the root space, completing the remaining goal while leaving the bench usable.
reaction: I was surprised that the screen protects the growing beds below the window while keeping the seat and worktop clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heat store was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how a separate heat-exchange circuit saves processor heat for the roots after the processor stops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the inner screen felt like a predictable intermediate step, with little detail until it was fitted.

surprise.text: The screen encloses the root space below the bench rather than the seating area, and folds open to admit light during the day.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the materials and connections had clear purposes, though the screen's final arrangement was not clear until it was fitted.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the growing nook and stored heat help the crops, and what happens next in the expedition.
